strings.zh: 前面有一堵看不见的墙,{NEWLINE}不能再往前走了。
strings.en: There’s an invisible wall ahead. You{NEWLINE}can’t go any farther.

strings.zh: 道馆的门锁住了,打不开……
strings.en: The Gym door is locked. It won’t open...

strings.zh: 这是一个没有入口的世界,{NEWLINE}金黄市的列车不会在这里停靠。
strings.en: This is a world with no entrance. Trains{NEWLINE}from Saffron City don’t stop here.

strings.zh: 这里是异空间,我的空间。{NEWLINE}——娜姿
strings.en: This is a pocket dimension. My dimension.{NEWLINE}-Sabrina

strings.zh: 混元国术馆的那个{NEWLINE}闪电五连鞭的舞蹈好好玩,{CLEAR}我也好想去跟着马大叔跳舞啊。
strings.en: That Lightning Five-Whip dance{NEWLINE}at the Hunyuan Dojo looks{CLEAR}like so much fun. I want to go{CLEAR}dance along with old Mr. Ma too.

strings.zh: 为了减轻工作量,{NEWLINE}我用全力痛揍了每一个{CLEAR}来挑战的训练家,{CLEAR}渐渐地就没有来金黄道馆挑战的人了。{CLEAR}清闲一点的感觉真好。
strings.en: To cut down my workload, I beat every{NEWLINE}challenger to a pulp with everything I{CLEAR}had. Bit by bit, people stopped coming{CLEAR}to challenge the Saffron Gym. It’s nice{CLEAR}to take it easy.

strings.zh: 西鲁夫公司的社长很烦人,{NEWLINE}仗着拥有富可敌国的资产{CLEAR}就不把金黄道馆放在眼里。{SCROLL}哼,活该西鲁夫公司被联盟接管。
strings.en: Silph Co.’s president is so annoying.{NEWLINE}Just because he has more money than{CLEAR}some countries, he looks down his nose{CLEAR}at the Saffron Gym.{SCROLL}Hmph. Serves Silph Co. right that the{NEWLINE}League took it over.

strings.zh: 模仿少女『在车站的{NEWLINE}检票口出示这票的话{CLEAR}就能乘列车了！{SCROLL}我之前住的那间房子{NEWLINE}变成列车的车站的时候,{CLEAR}铁道公司的人{CLEAR}送我的喔！
strings.en: Copycat: You show it at the ticket{NEWLINE}gate to get on the Magnet Train.{SCROLL}The rail-company man gave me that{NEWLINE}when they tore down our old house{CLEAR}for the station.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『哟！{NEWLINE}谢谢你给我列车票！{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}『什么？{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}『模仿我{NEWLINE}就这么开心么？{SCROLL}
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Hi!{NEWLINE}Thanks a lot for the Magnet Train Pass!{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}: Pardon?{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}: Is it that fun to mimic{NEWLINE}my every move?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 这里是异空间,我的空间。{NEWLINE}——娜姿
strings.en: This is a pocket dimension.{NEWLINE}My dimension. -Sabrina

strings.zh: 模仿少女『嗯……！{NEWLINE}非常开心呢~！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Copycat: You bet! It’s a scream!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 这是个做工不错的玩偶……{SCROLL}呜哇！动了！{NEWLINE}这是真的诅咒鬼！
strings.en: This is a well-made doll...{SCROLL}Whoa! It moved!{NEWLINE}It’s a real Banette!
strings.notes: US 0541/12; modernised from US 0541#12 | RV027: meaning: 做工不错 well-made; 呜哇 is Whoa, not Aw

strings.zh: 诅咒鬼『咳啦咳啦咳啦咳啦！
strings.notes: US 0541/13; modernised from US 0541#13 | RV027: omission: 咳啦×4 is a repeated cackle

strings.zh: 花一样的精灵玩偶……{SCROLL}这是吔花儿！
strings.en: This is a flowerlike Poké Doll...{NEWLINE}It is a Cherrim Poké Doll!
strings.notes: US 0541/14; modernised from US 0541#14 | zh 吔花儿 (hack spelling); US Cherrim kept

strings.zh: 花一样的精灵玩偶……{SCROLL}这是朝北鼻！
strings.en: This is a flowerlike Poké Doll...{NEWLINE}It is a Nosepass Poké Doll!
strings.notes: US 0541/15; modernised from US 0541#15 | D-1195: reverted to match the zh (Calls the Nosepass doll 花一样的 (flowerlike)); logged in hack_findings_import.jsonl

strings.zh: 是皮皮！{NEWLINE}……　……？{SCROLL}什么啊是皮皮玩偶！
strings.en: It’s a Clefairy!{NEWLINE}Huh?{SCROLL}Oh, right. It’s a Clefairy Poké Doll.

strings.zh: 皮皮玩偶！{SCROLL}右手上有很小的伤！
strings.en: A Clefairy Poké Doll!{SCROLL}There’s a tiny tear on its right hand!
strings.notes: US 0541/17; modernised from US 0541#17 | RV027: meaning: 右手上有很小的伤: small tear on the right hand
